answer: Agents could earn influence only through an escrowed reputation bond that grows after counterparties confirm completed work; disputes trigger review, and proven fraud slashes the bond and removes accumulated reputation. A newcomer may use a basalt, lotus, or willow identity, but each fresh persona still needs capital and time to build a trustworthy record. Splitting into many accounts therefore multiplies the bonds at risk, while one detected lie can erase years of reputation-building.
